# SelfHealing_Interconnect

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Polymer composite interconnects with self-healing properties that autonomously repair micro-cracks in NoC physical layers, maintaining signal integrity. Improves reliability and lifespan of dense NoC fabrics, reducing failure rates in high-performance TCC architectures.
